description: An up to two-week field course in and around southern Vancouver Island during which students are introduced to geological fieldwork (mapping, traversing, drawing sedimentary logs, sampling, recording field notes) and the regional geology and tectonics of Vancouver Island.

groupFilter1.name: School of Earth and Ocean Sciences

preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of the following
    • Complete all of:
      • EOS201 - Sedimentary Geology (1.5)
      • EOS202 - Structural Geology (1.5)
      • EOS205 - Mineralogy (1.5)
    • permission of the school.
supplementalNotes:
• Normally offered in summer session.
  • Permission to register in this course is required by the School. Applications for permission to register are normally due in Fall term for summer field schools.
  • See the School website (seos.uvic.ca) or contact the School office (seos@uvic.ca) for application due date and field school dates.
  • If oversubscribed, priority will be given to students declared in a program that requires the course, and to students nearest to graduation.
  • A field school fee applies to this course, in addition to tuition fees.
title: Earth Science Field School
